questions.question: 49th Parallel is the boundary line between which two countries?
questions.solution: 49th Parallel is the boundary between USA and Canada. It is a border between Canadian provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba and Saskatchewan in the north and US states of Idaho, Minnesota, North Dakota, Washington and Montana in the south.

questions.question: How does La-Nina affect the Pacific Ocean?

options.text: Cools downs the temperature of water

questions.solution:
• La-Nina is a coupled ocean-atmosphere phenomena which is a counterpart of El-Nino. When it occurs, the sea surface temperature across the Pacific Ocean decreases by 3 to 5-degree Celsius than normal.
 
• It affects the Pacific Ocean by cooling down the temperature of water.

questions.question: Which among the following carries impure blood to human heart?
questions.solution:
• Vena Cava is responsible for carrying impure blood to the human heart.
 
• Aorta is the largest artery of the body.
 
• Pulmonary veins are responsible for carrying oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
 
• Pulmonary arteries carry deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

questions.question: Which of the following is an ore of Aluminium?
questions.solution:
Cryolite is an ore of aluminium. It overcomes the difficulty of separating aluminium from oxygen in the oxide ores when used as a flux.

Galena is the natural mineral form of lead sulphide.

Cinnabar is derived from mercury sulphide.

Epsom salt is magnesium sulphate which is an inorganic salt.

questions.question: Fundamental duties are mentioned in which of the following part of Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: The Fundamental duties are mentioned in Part IV A of Indian Constitution. There are 11 Fundamental duties as of now. These were added by the 42nd and the 86th Constitutional Amendment acts.

questions.question: Which colour is formed when Red and Green are mixed?
questions.solution:
You obtain yellow color when you mix red and green

When you mix white with dark blue you get light blue

When white is mixed with black, grey is obtained.

questions.question: What is the name of the scheme for the Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) beneficiaries launched in Delhi region?
questions.solution:
The scheme which was launched in Delhi region for the Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) beneficiaries was ‘Kahin bhi kabh ibhi’.

Under this the beneficiaries can visit day care units for minor ailments.

questions.question: 'My Story' is an autobiography of which famous cricketer?
questions.solution:
My Story is an autobiography of cricketer Michael Clarke.

He is known to be the greatest batsman of his generation and possessed a sharp tactical mind on the game, as a captain.

questions.question: Who amongst the following was the successor of Sikh Guru Har Krishan?
questions.solution: Guru Tegh Bahadur was the successor of Sikh Guru Har Krishan. Guru Tegh Bahadur was the 9th of 10 gurus of the Sikh religion. His 116 poetic hymns are registered in the Guru Granth Sahib.

questions.question: What is the full form of JPEG?
questions.solution:
JPEG stands for Joint Photographic Experts Group.

It is a standard method of compressing graphic images and is used for storing images or sending them over the Internet.

The images are saved with a file extension name of .jpeg after they are compressed.

questions.question: Which country has approved more than 500 new settler homes in East Jerusalem?
questions.solution:
Israel has approved more than 500 new settler homes in East Jerusalem.

More than half a million of Israelis live in the Jewish-only settlements throughout the West Bank which includes East Jerusalem as well. According to the international law, they are considered illegal.

questions.question: Which of the following gas was released during Bhopal gas tragedy?
questions.solution:
Methyl isocyanate was released during the Bhopal Gas Tragedy.

The incident took place on the night of 2-3 December, 1984 at the Union Carbide India Limited plant in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

3787 people died because of the gas release.

questions.question: Which among the following is an example of micro-economic variable?
questions.solution: Consumer’s equilibrium is the example of micro-economic variable. Consumer Equilibrium allows a consumer to obtain maximum satisfaction possible from his income.

questions.question: The term 'Gambit' is associated with which of the following sport?
questions.solution:
• The term Gambit is associated with Chess.
 
• Gambit is a chess opening in which a player, mostly white, sacrifices material in a hope to achieve a resulting advantageous position.

questions.question: What is the minimum age for becoming a Governor of state in India?
questions.solution:
• The minimum age for becoming Governor of a state in India is 35 years.
 
• He should be a citizen of India and should not be a member of house of state legislature or any of the Parliament houses.

questions.question: Insulin is a kind of ________.
questions.solution: Insulin is a kind of a hormone which is made by the pancreas and allows your body to sugar (glucose) from the carbohydrates from the food that you eat in order to obtain energy or to store glucose for future use.

questions.question: What is an endothermic reaction?

options.text: Reaction in which heat is released.
Reaction in which heat is absorbed.
Reaction in which neither heat is released nor absorbed.

questions.solution:
An endothermic reaction is a reaction in which heat is absorbed.

An exothermic reaction is a reaction in which heat is released.

questions.question: Madhuri Dixit is associated with which Indian Dance form?
questions.solution:
Madhuri Dixit is an Indian Bollywood actress who is known for her work in Hindi cinema. She is a great actor and a dancer.

She is a trained professional Kathak dancer.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not an instrument of credit control in India?
questions.solution: Variable cost reserve ratios is not an instrument of credit control in India. It is an expression to find a company’s variable production costs in terms of percentage of sales, calculated by dividing the variable cost by total revenues.

questions.question: Cinnamon is obtained from which part of the plant?
questions.solution: Cinnamon is a spice which is obtained from the inner bark of several tree species of Cinnamomum. It is mainly used as a spice and a flavoring condiment in various cuisines.

questions.question: Lord Cornwallis is known for ________.

options.text: Land revenue settlement of United States

questions.question: Why does a water tank filled with water appear shallower when viewed from the top?
questions.solution:
• A water tank filled with water appears shallower when viewed from the top because of refraction of light.
 
• Light travels straight in the water, but it emerges obliquely into the air from water. While exiting, it bends downward towards the surface and this bending is called refraction.
 
• This phenomenon occurs when light passes from one transparent medium to another of a different density.

questions.question: Who among the following is a Sanjay Chopra Award recipient for 2016?
questions.solution:
Arjun Singh, who fought with a tiger in Uttarakhand to save his mother, was the recipient of Sanjay Chopra Award in 2016.

He along with 24 other children were honoured with National Bravery Awards at Republic Day celebrations.

These children were honoured by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and were a part of Republic Day parade.
